apk.notes: Scan Cards on the phone (a photo of the cards → Incoming Product lines; a shop owner sets it up in Settings → Card Scanner with the shop's Ximilar key). Description 1 is now the card name and number ("Charizard ex 223/197") and Description 2 the set, for Upload TCG Player CSV, pasting TCGplayer columns and Scan Cards alike.

web.notes: Shops are easier to tell apart: the shop lists on the computer and phone show when each shop was started, how many transactions it has, which computer keeps it, or that it's empty. A same-name copy can be removed. Using an empty shop (one made on a phone first) puts the computer's inventory and transactions in it instead of making a second shop. The phone's Set up your shop screen now points to the computer first.
